brief: The canvas displays a detailed, futuristic spaceship control panel composed of various switches, dials, and buttons. All inactive switches emit a distinct, deep red glow. A prominent windscreen viewing area occupies the center of the panel. The user interacts by clicking specific buttons on the panel. When the correct button is activated, the screen changes dramatically: the background through the windscreen animates, visually simulating the spaceship entering a vibrant, streaking hyperspace tunnel.

statement: This sketch creates a futuristic spaceship control panel with multiple interactive elements including switches and buttons. The interface features a dark, high-tech aesthetic with glowing red elements representing inactive components. When the user clicks the correct button (a prominent red button at the center), the entire display transforms into an animated hyperspace tunnel effect. The visualization uses particle-based streaks and spiraling patterns to simulate the sensation of rapid space travel. The design maintains the requested visual distinction between active and inactive elements while providing a clear interactive feedback mechanism that triggers the dramatic visual transformation.
